answer: Refunds at the wharf are gated by cluster size. The trigger is a withdrawal claim: a bond releases only after thirty settled epochs, and every sibling identity sharing its funding root stretches that clock by ten more. Each fake identity costs 20000 POA locked for 1,020 epochs before its first coin, so a hundred fakes strand two million POA while the vine of linked roots holds the capital and the fable of a free fleet starves; an honest agent draws out on schedule.
